review_method: Read every exact specification, relevant implementation and existing recorded evidence. Read-only reconciliation; no tests rerun, no code changes, no main-ledger update. status_policy: Suggestions use existing ledger statuses. IN_PROGRESS includes locally implemented but not fully accepted requirements. NOT_STARTED marks the explicitly parked fasting product. No requirement is marked VERIFIED by this shard.
evidence_caveat: Earlier slice documents may predate account integration. ACCOUNT_SYNC_EVIDENCE is the newer local transport proof and proves a Habit smoke journey, not hosted email, physical devices or the full Health/financial matrix. Snapshot/export completeness does not include previously compacted observations.
